        context = await browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 1800})

        # Try to find any button or input for login
        buttons = await page.get_by_role("button").all()
        print(f"\nButtons found: {len(buttons)}")

                name = await btn.name()
                visible = await btn.is_visible()
                print(f"  - Button: '{name}' (visible: {visible})")
            except:
                pass
        
        # Look for inputs
        inputs = await page.get_by_role("textbox").all()
        print(f"\nInputs found: {len(inputs)}")
        for inp in inputs[:10]:
            try:
                name = await inp.get_attribute("name") or "no-name"
                placeholder = await inp.get_attribute("placeholder") or ""
                visible = await inp.is_visible()
                print(f"  - Input: name='{name}', placeholder='{placeholder}' (visible: {visible})")
            except:
                pass
        
        await browser.close()

asyncio.run(main())
